chunks: 1506 - Sayyid al-'Abidin 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام said: “Indeed, among the signs that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has ordained for the people, from that which they need, is the sea which Allah created between the heaven and the earth.”

He said: “And indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has ordained therein the courses of the sun, the moon, and the stars, and He ordained all of that upon the celestial sphere. Then He appointed over the sphere an angel, with whom are seventy thousand angels, and they rotate the sphere. So when they rotate it, the sun, the moon, and the stars rotate with it, and descend into their stations which Allah the Exalted ordained for their day and night. Then when the sins of the servants become many, and Allah loves to make them seek His good pleasure by a sign from His signs, He commands the angel entrusted with the sphere to move the sphere away from its courses.”
He said: “Then the angel commands the seventy thousand angels: Remove the sphere from its courses.”

He said: “So they move it, and the sun comes to be in that sea in which the sphere had been, and its light is obscured and its color changes. Then when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, wills to magnify the sign, it is immersed in the sea according to how He wills to frighten His servants by the sign.”

He said: “And that is at the time of the eclipse of the sun, and likewise is done with the moon. Then when Allah, Mighty and Majestic, wills to uncover it and return it to its course, He commands the angel entrusted with the sphere to return the sphere to its course. So he returns the sphere, and the sun returns to its course.”
He said: “Then it emerges from the water while it is dim, and the moon is like that.”

He said: Then 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام said: “Indeed, none is alarmed by the two signs, nor fears, except one who is from our Shi'ah. So when that occurs from them, then flee to Allah the Exalted and turn back to Him.”

key_terms.الْآيَاتِ: the signs through which Allah warns and reminds His servants
key_terms.الْبَحْرَ: the sea created between the heaven and the earth in this cosmological description
key_terms.الْفَلَكِ: the celestial sphere upon which the heavenly bodies are set
key_terms.رَاجِعُوهُ: return to Allah in repentance and recourse
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: the followers and partisans of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.فَافْزَعُوا: seek refuge urgently and turn in alarm
key_terms.مَجَارِيَ: the ordained courses or paths of the sun, moon, and stars

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Zain al-'Abidin عليه السلام say about the cause and meaning of solar and lunar eclipses?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the eclipse of the sun and moon as divine signs governed by Allah through angelic agency and cosmic order. It presents these events as warnings that should move believers, especially the Shi'ah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, to turn back to Allah the Exalted in fear, reflection, and recourse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1506 - Imam Zain al-Abidin Ali ibn al-Hussein (as) said:
"Among the signs that Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, has decreed for people and that they are in need of is the sea which Allah (swt) created between the sky and the earth."

Imam (as) continued, "Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has arranged within it the courses of the sun, the moon, and the stars, and He has placed all of these upon a celestial sphere. He has assigned an angel to this sphere, along with seventy thousand other angels, and they rotate the sphere. When they cause it to rotate, the sun, moon, and stars also rotate with it, moving into the positions that Allah (swt) has ordained for them for each day and night. When the sins of the servants increase and Allah (swt) wills to warn them with a sign from His signs, He commands the angel in charge of the celestial sphere to move it from its usual course."
Imam (as) said: "The angel commands the seventy thousand angels to shift the sphere from its course."

Imam (as) added, "As a result, the sun descends into the sea where the celestial sphere is, causing its light to be obscured and its color to change. If Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, wills to make the sign more significant, He immerses it further into the sea, as He desires to instill fear in His servants with this sign."

Imam (as) continued, "This happens during a solar eclipse, and the same occurs with the moon. When Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious, wills to reveal and return it to its course, He commands the angel in charge of the sphere to restore it. The angel then returns it to its course, and the sun emerges from the water, appearing dim, and the moon experiences the same."

Then, Imam Zain al-Abidin Ali ibn al-Hussein said: "No one becomes fearful of these signs or is filled with awe except those who are from our followers. When such signs occur, seek refuge with Allah (swt) the Exalted and turn to Him."
